🎥🎬: Jumanji: Open World (2026)

FOUR LEGENDS. ONE FINAL MISSION. 💥🌍
Dwayne Johnson, Kevin Hart, Jack Black, and Karen Gillan are back together for another chapter in the world of Jumanji. What awaits the team this time remains a mystery, but one thing is certain: their journey promises more action, more comedy, and more unexpected surprises.
As they prepare to face another extraordinary challenge, the group must once again depend on each other to navigate the madness. Their friendship has carried them through incredible adventures, but this final chapter could be their most memorable yet.
The ultimate adventure is calling. Will you answer? 👀🎮

source_details.synopsis: Jumanji: Open World is an upcoming American action-adventure film co-produced and directed by Jake Kasdan, who co-wrote it with Jeff Pinkner and Scott Rosenberg. It is the fifth and final installment in the Jumanji film series and the sequel to Jumanji: The Next Level (2019). Dwayne Johnson, Jack Black, Kevin Hart, Karen Gillan, Alex Wolff, Madison Iseman, Morgan Turner, Ser'Darius Blain, Rhys Darby, Nick Jonas, and Danny DeVito reprise their roles from the previous films. The film is scheduled to be released in the United States on December 25, 2026.
